# ProposalWithdrawScope

`schemas/api/scope/proposal-withdraw.json`

The scope of proposal.withdraw (docs/design/m0/04 "Proposals and confirmation"): the proposal to withdraw. Its project and object are the proposal's, derived server side. Only its proposer or an operator withdraws it, and only while it is open and unexpired.
